data.description:
## Summary

The three-probe sandbox enforcement suite never runs on Linux in CI. It skips, silently, and a
green `Verified +1` cannot be distinguished from the tests having executed.

## Mechanism

- `scripts/mutation_sandbox.py:113-115` records it in the merged code's own words: GitHub's
  ubuntu runners ship bubblewrap but DENY unprivileged user namespaces
  (`bwrap: setting up uid map: Permission denied`), so the functional probe `_bwrap_works()`
  correctly reports no usable mechanism.
- With `probe()` returning `None`, the `@live` skipif at `tests/scripts/test_mutation_sandbox.py:61-64`
  fires and all four enforcement tests skip.
- Under `-q` a skip prints as a dot-adjacent 's' and is invisible in the CI summary.

## Why this matters

The macOS Seatbelt path is verified on-host (28 passed, zero skips, real deny observed). The
Linux path is therefore an UNVERIFIED CAPABILITY: bwrap's write-deny has never been observed
executing anywhere. `chiffon-venomous-annelida` AC6 was written precisely to prevent inferring
the Linux result from the macOS one, and it is not met.

## Contradiction worth resolving

Two commits disagree. `b63cf799ed90` installs bubblewrap in the workflow specifically so these
tests would NOT skip on Linux. `a26a73277c8a` then documents that they still find no mechanism
there. One of the two is stale.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The three-probe enforcement test is OBSERVED executing (not skipping) on a Linux runner,
      with the outside-deny probe exiting non-zero and the file absent afterward.
- [ ] If GitHub-hosted ubuntu cannot grant the required namespaces, the chosen resolution is
      recorded with its reasoning — e.g. a different mechanism, a container with the capability,
      or an explicit decision that Linux enforcement is out of scope.
- [ ] A skip of these tests is made LOUD rather than silent, so a future regression to
      'no mechanism' cannot pass as green.
- [ ] The b63cf799ed90 / a26a73277c8a contradiction is resolved in whichever direction is true.
data.title: Mutation-sandbox enforcement tests SKIP on ubuntu-latest, so the Linux write-deny is unproven
